analogy.rationale: Serotonin receptors are barely expressed in these cell lines, so partial agonists should elicit little transcriptional response; other serotonin receptor ligands and GPCR antagonists acting on poorly expressed receptors should behave similarly, while SSRI and histamine agonists share only weak monoamine/GPCR-related overlap.
